svg.title: Agentic travel assistant on AWS
svg.desc: A client calls API Gateway protected by Cognito, which invokes a Lambda running a Strands agent on Bedrock Nova Lite. The agent uses S3 for session memory, a Bedrock knowledge base for retrieval, and AgentCore Gateway MCP tools for attractions.
